info.name: Generate a document from preset section definitions

params.name: stream
params.description: If true, stream SSE progress events.

items.docs:
Generate a document using preset section definitions resolved from the registry.

    Provide a document_type (e.g., "project_specification", "technical_specification")
    and optional overrides. Section definitions are automatically resolved.

    **Modes:**
    - `stream=true` (default): Returns SSE stream with real-time progress events
    - `stream=false`: Blocks until complete, returns the final GeneratedDocument as JSON

info.name: Regenerate a single section of an existing document

params.name: section_name
params.description: Name of the section to regenerate

params.name: stream
params.description: If true, stream SSE progress events. If false, block until complete and return document JSON.

items.docs:
Regenerate one section of a previously generated document.

    Uses the original document's configuration (style, queries, section definitions)
    and injects dependency context from existing sibling sections.

    Only the requested section is regenerated — dependent sections are NOT
    cascaded.

    **Modes:**
    - `stream=true` (default): Returns SSE stream with progress events
    - `stream=false`: Blocks until complete, returns the updated GeneratedDocument as JSON
